title: GTA 6 Just Scored a 99 on Metacritic: The Highest-Rated GTA Ever 🏆 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 reviews are out. On Metacritic, Grand Theft Auto VI has a Metascore of 99 based on more than 100 critic reviews, 100% positive, with zero mixed and zero negative reviews (as of Nov 18, 2026; the score can change as more reviews arrive). That beats GTA IV's 98, the previous series record, and GTA V's 97, and ties The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time at 99. Edge Magazine gave it 100. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Source: Metacritic (critic reviews for Grand Theft Auto VI). Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.
